title: Matrix from row lists
statement: For natural numbers $p$ and $m$ and a list $R$ of lists of natural numbers, define an $m\times m$ matrix over $\mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z$ by setting its $(i,j)$ entry to the residue class of the $j$th entry of the $i$th row of $R$, using $0$ whenever either entry is absent.
